title: QI-VC Verification Policy v1
description: Six deterministic rules that constitute a complete verification of a QI domain credential chain (DCC or DRMD). Rules are applied in order; any FAIL terminates the chain as invalid.

rules.name: issuer-is-capability-subject
rules.description: Domain credential issuer DID must equal the CapabilityCredential credentialSubject.id.

rules.name: accreditation-issuer-trusted
rules.description: AccreditationCredential issuer DID must be listed in the TrustRegistryCredential. Additionally the CapabilityCredential constraints must be a subset of (or equal to) the AccreditationCredential scope (derivation check).

subrules.name: issuer-in-trust-registry
subrules.description: AccreditationCredential issuer DID appears in TrustRegistryCredential registryEntries.

subrules.name: derivation-valid
subrules.description: CapabilityCredential constraints.scopeEntries are a subset of AccreditationCredential scope (DERIVATION_VIOLATION check per paper §6.2).

rules.name: temporal-validity
rules.description: AccreditationCredential validFrom ≤ domain credential validFrom ≤ AccreditationCredential validUntil. CapabilityCredential temporal window must also cover the domain credential.

rules.name: status-bit-clear
rules.description: All credentials in the chain (domain, capability, accreditation) that carry a credentialStatus of type BitstringStatusListEntry must have their status bit unset (i.e., not revoked or suspended).

rules.name: hash-binding-matches
rules.description: Every evidence entry of type CapabilityCredentialReference or AccreditationCredentialReference must carry a hashBinding whose digestMultibase equals SHA-256(URDNA2015(referenced-credential)), encoded as multibase base58btc.

rules.name: scope-covers-payload
rules.description: Domain credential claims must fall within the CapabilityCredential constraints.scopeEntries. For DCC: measured value in range, method in allowedMethods, expanded uncertainty ≤ scope bound. For DRMD: certified properties in allowedProperties, uncertainty ≤ scope bound.

ReferenceMaterialCertificate.note: Only isCertified=true property groups are checked; informative values are excluded.

reasonCodes.description: Calibration method not in authorized set.
Certified element or matrix outside scope.
No scope entry covers the reported measurand.
Accreditation body DID not in trust registry.
Evidence hash binding does not match referenced credential.
